sections.text: The Oil Coolers Out of Service

items:
The cold medium should it be necessary to stop 
 the cold fluid first.

Isolate the oil coolers by closing the inlet 
 and discharge valves.
Insure that the other oil cooler is in service.

Isolate the oil cooler from both sides oil and 
 water and drain oil in an empty barrel.

Dismantle the reversing bonnet of the cooler 
 and take it out.

Dismantle the bolts of flange connecting the 
 cooler shell with its base.

Dismantle the bolts of inlet and outlet oil 
 flanges.

Tight the shells from its eye bolt and lift it 
 to an empty place.

Clean tubes by using a soft rod or water lance 
 one by one till you be insured that all tubes internally cleaned.

Clean the surface of tubes to remove the greasy 
 oil and other impurities by using acid cleaning.

Insure that the area around the tubes bundle is 
 clean.

Lift the cooler shell and put it in its place 
 after putting the gasket between the shell flange and its base flange.

Tighten the shell flange bolts firmly according 
 to their tighten torque with a torque wrench.

For making hydro test to check for leak we 
 should performed the following steps:

Put a blind flange on the outlet or inlet 
 flange which ever is the higher.

Connect the discharge pipe of a hand pump to 
 the other flange of cooler.

Pressurized the cooler with clean water and 
 notice any leaks from the upper side of tubes.

Plug the cracked tubes from the upper side 
 first by using useful wooden plug.

Dismantle the discharge pipe flange of the hand 
 pump and dismantle the flange connecting the shell with the base and other 
 side of the cracked tubes firmly.

Put the cooler shell again in its place and 
 tighten its connecting flange with base.

Tighten the bolts of the inlet and outlet oil 
 flanges.

Tighten the reversing bonnet of the cooler 
 shell.

Put the cooler in operation and notice the 
 outlet temperature of oil and record it hourly.

Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, 
to be 
performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
Inspect all protective closures and if damaged 
investigate for internal contamination.
If damaged is extensive the carrier.

Safety Precautions
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen mechanically and electrically.
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the Suitable safety category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.

 breaker of the pump motor.

Work to be Carried Out
The Oil Coolers in Service
Check the pressure of oil pumps.
Check the difference between outlet and inlet 
 temperature in the oil coolers (not exceed 4.3

The Oil Coolers Out of Service
The cold medium should it be necessary to stop

Isolate the oil coolers by closing the inlet 
 and discharge valves.

Insure that the other oil cooler is in service.

Dismantle the bolts of flange connecting the 
 cooler shell with its base.
Dismantle the bolts of inlet and outlet oil

Tight the shells from its eye bolt and lift it 
 to an empty place.
Clean tubes by using a soft rod or water lance

Clean the surface of tubes to remove the greasy

Assembly
Insure that the area around the tubes bundle is 
 clean.
Lift the cooler shell and put it in its place 
 after putting the gasket between the shell flange and its base flange.
Tighten the shell flange bolts firmly according 
 to their tighten torque with a torque wrench.
For making hydro test to check for leak we

Put a blind flange on the outlet or inlet

Connect the discharge pipe of a hand pump to

Pressurized the cooler with clean water and 
 notice any leaks from the upper side of tubes.
Plug the cracked tubes from the upper side

Dismantle the discharge pipe flange of the hand

 side of the cracked tubes firmly.
Put the cooler shell again in its place and 
 tighten its connecting flange with base.
Tighten the bolts of the inlet and outlet oil 
 flanges.
Tighten the reversing bonnet of the cooler 
 shell.
Put the cooler in operation and notice the
